_comment: What the voice check reads, and whether it blocks. Every deck here is product copy, so the tier is always 'hard': the mechanical bans only, never the sentence rules. Shortening an assessment criterion to satisfy a linter would damage a regulated qualification. FIRST MATCHING TARGET WINS, so the blocking entries must stay above the catch-all. A page moves out of the backlog and into the blocking list the moment it is swept clean, so the backlog count only ever goes down. See scripts/voice-check.mjs.
